plain_summary_en: This paper studies When Eating Becomes Collaborative: Co-Eating Examples from Children’s Mealtimes. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Eating, When, Becomes, Collaborative. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
